text:
Mark Scheifele passed Dale Hawerchuk for the most goals in Jets history on Nov. 21 against Vegas, tying that game 3-3, as Jesse Granger of The Athletic put it in real time. It came in the middle of his best stretch of the season: 19 points in his last ten games, against the 12.3 we'd expect at his ice time, with a four-game point streak running.

Our numbers call the hot run earned. He is getting more chances on his own shots than usual, and his goals are actually a little behind his expected goals. The caution sits elsewhere: Winnipeg has scored 7.2 more goals than its chances deserved with him on the ice, which pads his 33 points. He is still a setup man first. Corey Sznajder's All Three Zones tracking put him in the 99th percentile for primary shot assists last season, though Evolving-Hockey also had him in the bottom 3% of forwards defensively. Our numbers project about 103 points. Watch the on-ice goals against when the bounces even out.
headline: Scheifele owns the Jets record book now
